changelog:
v2.10.6 - Freezer visibility fix + Direct send no longer hangs.

- FREEZER: frozen apps no longer vanish from the list. The scanner now sees apps in disabled-user and Knox-suspended states, so Unfreeze All and the Doctor can find and restore them.
- DIRECT SEND: shrinking now has a 90s watchdog; if it stalls it falls back to sending the original. Upload retries are bounded and every failure shows the exact reason instead of loading forever.
